entities.summary: Domenico Calcagno is an Italian prelate of the Catholic Church. He has been a bishop since 2002 and a cardinal since 2012. From 7 July 2011 to 26 June 2018, he was President of the Administration of the Patrimony of the Holy See, where he had served as secretary since 2007.
